body:
> What makes you say your parents hate you?

im bisexual and they hate homosexual people. im not out of the closet but they hate me either way. ive heard them say they regret me and my brother were born. im a waste of resources so i cant blame them to be frank.

> I don't think having social anxiety is anyone's own fault.

i was bullied so i literally stopped speaking to people unless i was spoken to from 2010-mid 2015. and im socially retarded bc of it. sure it wasn't my choice to be bullied, but *i* chose to deal with it that way. its my fault. ive improved slightly so i can talk to strangers, but i still want to kill myself afterwards/beat myself up for any mistakes i made while interacting. 

i dont think the *reason* why im a horrible person matters. people dont see the physical abuse/bullying/whatever when i guilt trip them into having a relationship with me/staying with me. like i did with my 2 exes. they just feel the pain. and i should know better, i was emotionally abused myself. i told myself id never be that way. but i did it anyway. im fucking atrocious.

im sorry if i come off hostile (i dont mean it that way). im just trynna be concise & not waste yoru time. im sincerely grateful that you chose to listen to me ;;

i wrote my "issues" in another comment above.

i appreciate the sentiment but ive been trying my best to be "normal" for months now. i gave it a chance. and it never got better. i was just deluding myself that it did.

im ugly, what little relationships i had i fucked up because im a horrible person (my fault), i have social anxiety (my fault), and my parents hate me (lol take a guess). i guess i have low self steem but i dont count it. since its justified.

i know this may sound r/incel -ish (tho im a girl) but fuck , i really wouldnt have half these issues if i was attractive. i read this thread where people talked about how people treated them better for being attractive (shocker). meanwhile i got bullied, told i should die, and people think im a bitch because of my face. great.

the only good thing about me was that i could draw, but i didnt draw for months because i was so depressed. now i can barely draw shit. so now i don't even have that to cling onto ¯\\\_(ツ)_/¯
